The '''Korriz system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] found in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriz]].
